notes.text:
कस्मात् सूत्रं न प्रयुक्तम्? · Why didn't rule apply? 
8.4.68
8.4.68: never offered in this derivation — its conditions were not even reached (or it is not implemented).==at the end of all prakriya it should come also in vidyut engine shown check this
notes.author: me
notes.verdict: Claude 2026-11-15 — Partly right. Kāśikā 8.4.68: the a-final word's vivṛta a becomes saṃvṛta (pratyāpatti) — so it belongs at the end of the derivation of rāmaḥ. But it changes no letter (only articulation) and the engine's 8.4.68 is a gate marker. Not offered is therefore harmless to the form. DECISION: recorded as S182, low priority, needs a prayatna field first. The 'show in the Vidyut panel' part is a display ask — not done, tell me which panel.
